skills.name: Attack
skills.note: Melee accuracy. Fight anything; start on goblins and cows.

skills.name: Hitpoints
skills.note: Rises with every combat skill you train.

skills.name: Mining
skills.note: Copper and tin to start, then iron, coal, gold, cobalt, verdite and glacite.

skills.name: Strength
skills.note: Melee max hit. Same targets as Attack.

skills.name: Agility
skills.note: Run laps of the obstacle courses.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.note: Smelt ore at a furnace, hammer bars on an anvil.

skills.name: Defence
skills.note: Damage reduction. Same targets as Attack.

skills.name: Herbalism
skills.note: Clean herbs and mix potions; buy vials and secondaries.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.note: Net minnows in the shallows; bait perch and pike in deep water.

skills.name: Ranged
skills.note: Shoot the targets, then real monsters.

skills.name: Thieving
skills.note: Steal from stalls and pickpocket townsfolk.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.note: Cook on a range for fewer burns, or on any fire.

skills.name: Devotion
skills.note: Bury bones; pray at altars to recharge.

skills.name: Crafting
skills.note: Spin flax, make pottery, cut gems and tan hides.

skills.name: Firemaking
skills.note: Light logs anywhere on open ground.

skills.name: Magic
skills.note: Cast spells; glyphs and staves from the glyph shops.

skills.name: Fletching
skills.note: Cut logs into bows and arrows.

skills.name: Woodcutting
skills.note: Trees, oaks, willows by water, yews in Elderglen, starwood trees.

skills.name: Glyphcraft
skills.note: Mine aether stone at the Wizards' Spire, then inscribe glyphs at the shrines.

skills.name: Bounty
skills.note: Take bounties from the bounty master.

skills.name: Farming
skills.note: Plant allotments, herbs, flowers and trees.

skills.name: Homesteading
skills.note: Buy a plot, make planks, build through the gate.

skills.name: Hunter
skills.note: Set snares and traps for birds and lizards.

skills.name: Sailing
skills.note: Build and crew ships from the south coast.
